spans.s:
n. (-नं)
1 Mons veneris.
2 The hip and loins.
E.
हन to kill or hurt, जवन substituted for the radical, and अच Uṇādi aff.

m. du. (-कौ)
The hollows of the loins of a handsome woman.
E.
जघन the loins, and कूपक a well or pit.

f. (-ला)
1 A woman active as in dancing.
2 A species of the Aryā metre.

f. (-ला)
Opposite leaved fig tree, (Ficus oppositi-folia, Rox.)
E.
जघन the haunch, &c. here put for the stem, and फल fruit; growing round the stem.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
1 Last, hindmost.
2 Low, vile, base.
3 Worst, vilest, lowest.
n. (-न्यं)
The penis.
m. (-न्यः)
A Śūdra or man of the fourth tribe.
E.
जघन the loins, &c. and यत् aff.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Vile, addicted to low pursuits.
E.
जघन्य vile, गुण quality, वृत्ति practice, and स्थ standing.

m. (-जः)
1 A Śūdra.
2 A younger brother or younger born.
E.
जघन्य last, and ज born.

mfn. (-वान्-नुषी-न्वत्)
Who or what kills.
E.
हन to kill, वसु affix, root repeated.

m. (-घ्निः)
A sharp or offensive weapon.
E.
हन to kill, affix कि, form irr.

mfn. (-घ्नुः-घ्नुः-घ्नु)
Striking, beating, injuring, one who does so.
E.
हन to hurt or kill, कु affix, and the radical reiterated.

mfn. (-वान्-घ्मुषी-वत्)
Killing, who or what kills.
E.
हन to kill, वसु affix, root repeated, इट् inserted.
